resync: git fetch --depth 1 langflow refs/tags/<newtag>:refs/tags/langflow-<newtag> && git subtree pull --prefix=apps/nufi-agent langflow-<newtag> --squash
resyncAlsoDo: 1) Update this file's own tag/commit fields to the new pin -- resyncing without bumping them here leaves upstream.json lying about what's vendored, and check-fork-diff.sh reads `tag` from this file to know what to diff against, so a stale tag makes the guard compare against the WRONG upstream release. 2) Run check-brand-css.sh (not just re-running rebrand.test.ts -- that only unit-tests rewrite() in isolation and proves the regex still works on sample strings, not that vite.config.mts still calls nufiRebrand(); check-brand-css.sh builds for real and asserts zero literal "Langflow" survives into build/assets/*.js, which is the only thing that actually proves the plugin is still wired in -- see nufi/README.md 'Verifying the rebrand-wiring guard'). 3) Run check-locale-parity.sh; an upstream release that adds English keys silently leaves Korean gaps. 4) Re-run the door/room sweep in nufi/README.md's 'Standing constraint' section by hand -- no guard catches a resync introducing a new translated nav item that opens onto a new untranslated namespace; see that section for why this step isn't automated.
